tweetText: Google Pay is revamping its payment system to handle transactions from AI agents with the new Universal Commerce Protocol. This shift could make Google Pay a key player in the future of automated buying. via AI News.

NBA Commissioner Adam Silver announced plans to implement an AI system for automatic out-of-bounds calls using cameras around the court. This could enhance officiating accuracy and fairness in games. via AI News.

Glean’s revenue has surged past $300M, tripling its annual earnings as it positions itself as a key player in AI-driven budget-cutting. This growth highlights the increasing demand for efficient AI solutions in the enterprise sector. via TechCrunch AI

AWS, Cloudflare, and others are revamping cloud infrastructure to accommodate a future where AI agents generate more internet traffic than humans. This shift could reshape how we interact with the web and optimize services for AI. via TechCrunch AI

Asana has acquired StackAI to enhance its AI workflow tools with no-code agent-building capabilities. This move aims to simplify automation for users, making their work more efficient. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic has raised $65 billion in its latest funding round, bringing its valuation close to $1 trillion ahead of its IPO. This significant investment highlights the growing confidence and interest in AI startups. via TechCrunch AI

Major exchanges are launching AI token futures, treating AI as a valuable resource like gold and oil. This shift could reshape the investment landscape, making AI a tradable asset class. via TechCrunch AI
Anthropic launched Opus 4.8, featuring a new tool called Dynamic Workflows to better manage multiple subagents. This advancement enhances AI coordination and efficiency. via TechCrunch AI

Elon Musk suggests that xAI's deal with Anthropic for SpaceX’s computing resources is short-term and could be canceled. This conflicting information raises questions about the stability and future of AI partnerships. via TechCrunch AI

Sesame, founded by Oculus creators, just launched its iOS app featuring conversational AI agents for more human-like interactions. This innovation could change how we communicate with technology, making it feel more personal. via TechCrunch AI
